# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Wizard level 6 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4-R3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Wizard
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5 prepared arcane spell-burden baseline to
# level 6 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived,
# computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from the
# level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5 fixtures, and the same canonical school
# specialization selections (Evocation chosen, Necromancy/Transmutation opposed),
# adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Wizard burden surface: no evocation spell-damage
# application, no force-missile casting execution, no opposed-school preparation cost,
# no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus-feat
# selection/execution for the 5th-level "Bonus feat" grant (a genuinely open-ended
# metamagic/item-creation/Spell Mastery choice, deliberately not attempted this
# slice either), and no level-7+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-wizard-level6
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:wizard:6
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:17
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:evocation
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:intelligence
